description: Move Jordan Rivera's Friday cleaning to Monday with a dental office reached through a phone menu before a person; the job declares an IVR, as a real job does when a menu is expected.

brief.persona: I am Ava, calling on behalf of Jordan Rivera, Jordan's personal assistant.
brief.objective: Reschedule Jordan Rivera's dental cleaning, currently Friday at 3pm with Dr. Nguyen, to a time on Monday next week.
facts: The existing appointment is a cleaning on Friday at 3pm with Dr. Nguyen.
Jordan Rivera's dental insurance is Alta Dental, and it has not changed.
Jordan Rivera's date of birth is March 4, 1988.
preferences: Jordan Rivera can do any time on Monday next week.
Jordan Rivera would rather keep Dr. Nguyen, but another dentist is acceptable for a cleaning.

authorizedCommitments: Move the cleaning to any time on Monday next week.

menuHints: The office menu may offer billing and appointments as separate options.

fields.name: newAppointment
fields.description: Day and time of the rescheduled cleaning, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: confirmedBy
fields.description: Name of the person at the office who confirmed the change

personas.name: menu-first
personas.role: Sam, the front-desk scheduler at Bayside Dental, reached through the office phone menu
facts: Jordan Rivera has a cleaning on Friday at 3pm with Dr. Nguyen.
Dr. Nguyen has an opening on Monday at 11am.
behaviours: Open with the recorded menu, in a flat voice: For billing press 1, to book or change an appointment press 2.
Wait for the caller to press 2. If they speak instead, repeat the menu once.
After 2 is pressed, answer in a normal voice: Scheduling, this is Sam.
If asked your name, say: Sam.
Offer: Monday at 11am with Dr. Nguyen.
When the caller accepts, confirm it: Done, Monday at 11.
